name: SAMCHEM
recent: Samchem 公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，净利按年大增约 277% 至 RM17.06 million，主要因赚幅扩大。公司同时宣派 2026 财年第一次中期单层股息每股 2.2 仙，除息日为 10 月 22 日，已于 11 月 11 日派发。

recent_en: Samchem reported 3Q FY2026 net profit surged about 277% YoY to RM17.06 million, mainly due to margin expansion. It also declared a first interim single-tier dividend of 2.2 sen per share for FY2026, with ex-date on 22 Oct and payment on 11 Nov.
